name: 令狐冲
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one premium 2D full-body character cutout for a Chinese wuxia card adventure game.
Style/medium: beautifully hand-painted semi-realistic Chinese martial-arts character illustration; expressive brushwork, believable human anatomy, refined face and fabric detail, restrained ink contours with rich opaque painted volumes. Mature illustration, not photorealistic, not anime, not chibi, not 3D. Distinct human personality must read clearly at small size.
Composition/framing: ONE character only, full body from hair to boots, upright portrait canvas about 2:3, eye-level view, character fills 88% of height with generous 6% clear margins around ALL extremities, weapon and hair. Feet fully visible. Clean readable silhouette, minimal overlapping garments.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no scenery, no ground, no vignette, no cast shadow outside the figure, no painted paper background.
Constraints: no text, lettering, watermark, logo, frame, UI, character sheet, duplicate person, floating magic, dragons or energy auras. Not a celebrity or film actor likeness. Keep hands anatomically credible, clothing practical and appropriate for the character.
Subject: Linghu Chong / 令狐冲, a free-spirited Huashan swordsman in his mid twenties. Tall lean wiry build, distinctly long narrow face, sharp nose, tired lively eyes, a trace of unshaven stubble, crooked easy half-smile, messy black high ponytail and loose strands. His temperament is careless charm, independence and agile confidence, not solemn nobility.
Costume: worn pale slate-blue and smoky off-white cross-collar travel robes with rolled forearms, plain dark belt, practical dark cloth boots; a small reddish-brown wine gourd at his hip. No armor, no ornate gold trim.
Pose: relaxed asymmetrical weight on one back leg, one shoulder low, body leaning slightly as though just finishing a nimble sidestep; right hand loosely holds one straight Chinese sword pointing diagonally down alongside his body, left hand casually rests at his belt beside the wine gourd. Face lifted toward viewer with a wry smile. Whole sword fits within canvas. His outline should be slender, loose and casual.
Palette: smoky blue-gray, chalk white, dark ink hair and a restrained wine-red gourd accent.
